issue.title: Add dedicated bounded mailbox vsock service and call/cast API
issue.body:
<!-- agent-pickup-triage:v1 -->
## Agent pickup triage

**Category: ready.** This classifies the next task, not completion or a verified current-source pass.

**Next bounded step:** Verify merged #4694 canonical-envelope and #4698 transport contracts, then implement the standalone bounded local vsock call/cast service with isolation tests.

Read the linked handoff and coordinate any active owner before implementation. Preserve the original acceptance criteria below; this triage grants no spending, credentials, publication, host reconfiguration, or landing authority.

---

Parent: #4622

Depends on #4627 and #4628.

## Outcome

Add a dedicated typed mailbox service over vsock with independent queues, credits, lifecycle, and authorization. It must work in standalone `mvm` without `mvmd` and must not share FlowMux, telemetry, or machine-control queues.

This service consumes `mvm-contract::protocol::mailbox` directly. It owns the workload-facing call/cast/reply behavior and local admission; it must not call into `mvmd-types` or require an `mvmd` process for identity, crypto, delivery, or receipts.

## Scope

- A separately registered mailbox vsock service and bounded framing.
- Guest and host APIs for `call` and `cast`, plus a separately named lossy operation only if the ADR admits one.
- Correlation IDs, reply routing, monotonic deadlines, cancellation, and safe disposal of late replies.
- Per-mailbox, per-sender, per-tenant, and host aggregate admission limits.
- Explicit local outcomes for full, backpressured, unauthorized, expired, unavailable, and shutting-down destinations.
- Clean boot, reconnect, shutdown, and teardown behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A guest and host can exchange typed calls and casts without `mvmd` or a guest NIC.
- [ ] Guest, host, and mock-I/O tests exchange the same canonical MVM envelope later consumed opaquely by cross-host transports and `mvmd` wrappers.
- [ ] Calls return correlated replies or typed timeout/cancellation results; late replies cannot satisfy a later call.
- [ ] Casts return after local admission and produce no application reply.
- [ ] A full queue fails according to the ADR and never silently drops an accepted normal message.
- [ ] Mailbox saturation cannot consume the configured credits or queues of control, telemetry, or FlowMux services.
- [ ] Malformed frames, unauthorized operations, oversized values, disconnects, and teardown are covered by integration tests over mock I/O and the supported vsock boundary.
- [ ] Dependency checks prove no MVM crate imports `mvmd-types` and no local mailbox path falls back to an `mvmd` API.
